cs.t: Likewise. I use this pole:  https://www.ergomart.com/192offset-monitor-floor-stand  . And this monitor:  https://www.rtings.com/monitor/reviews/lg/32ud99-w  (specifically because it's the only USB-C monitor I found that's completely flicker-free, which RTINGS tests for). Ergomart actually  looked at the specs of my monitor  and recommended the right arm and parts to properly balance the weight. I'll happily recommend them recommend them. The monitor moves easily on three axes, and tilts; cords are cable-managed through the pole. I just sit down and plug in a single USB-C cable to get video, webcam, keyboard/mouse, and power.
